inside: 8 agents: ICP Finder, Ad Spy, Angle Builder, Hook Writer, Brief Writer, Copywriter, Scaling Master, Refresh
A run sheet that runs all eight in order and keeps three hooks per angle
A 24-ad set sheet: hook, primary text, headline, CTA and brief for every ad
A worked example in every agent, on an invented brand and labelled
Install steps for Claude.ai Projects and Claude Code
proof: Built by the team that runs paid growth for DTC brands. RISE buys media for DTC brands and gets paid on the growth it adds. We used this same process on a brand that cut ad spend 40% and more than tripled profit in six months.
